Hi Nathan,

Thanks for confirming, the Hammer BC04 it is.

A colleague is picking this up today and sending you a payment link for the $111.68 difference ($249.00 for the BC04, less the $137.32 you paid for the GekkoAxe GT). You don't need to do anything until that lands in your inbox.

The BC04 is in stock here in the US, so once the difference is settled I reserve your unit right away. It ships as soon as your GekkoAxe reaches our Chattanooga warehouse, which is standard on a return like this. Your label is already live, the return still reads as on its way to us, so just drop the box at UPS with Shop···· written on the outside and I'll keep you posted when it arrives and when the BC04 goes out.

Sorry again for the wait on this one.

Best,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Nathan,

Thanks for following up, and sorry you had to.

Two things on my side. The return that was checked in this week is your Hammer DC08, which landed at our Chattanooga warehouse on November 5. The GekkoAxe box, reference Shop···· on UPS (number hidden), is still showing as not yet received there, so I've asked the warehouse to go and look for it. If it was delivered, it is sitting in receiving waiting to be booked in, and that gets sorted out at their end, not yours.

The second thing is on us. You asked how to pay the $111.68 difference for the Hammer BC04 nine days ago and no payment link reached you. A colleague is picking that up today and sending it to this address. As soon as it is settled your BC04 is reserved, and it goes out once the GekkoAxe is booked in with us.

I'll come back to you as soon as the warehouse confirms the box.

Best,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

On the return, your GekkoAxe box on UPS (number hidden) is still not booked in at our Chattanooga warehouse. I have asked them again to go and find it, because if UPS shows it delivered it is sitting in receiving. The Hammer DC08 you sent back on your other order is the one that was checked in on November 5, which is probably what you saw.

Sorry for how long this has dragged, I will come back to you the second either half moves.

Hi Nathan,

Straight answer: I can't generate that payment link myself, it has to be raised on the order by one of my colleagues, and I have pushed it again today with a direct ask to send it to you this afternoon. I'm sorry you've had to ask four times for it.

There is a second route if you'd rather not depend on that link. Once your GekkoAxe is booked in at our warehouse, I can put the $137.32 on your account as store credit, and you order the Hammer BC04 on the site yourself and apply the credit at checkout. Same $111.68 out of your pocket, and you control the timing. Say the word and I'll set that up the moment your unit is received.

Either way, the GekkoAxe return on UPS (number hidden) still isn't checked in at Chattanooga, and I've asked them again to find it. Nothing ships back out to you before that box is booked in, which is the one rule I can't bend.

The BC04 is in stock in the US, so neither route is held up by availability.

Best,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
